time_convention: t = frame / 33; frame = round(t * 33); frame 0 = t 0
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left of the full-resolution frame) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the upper building band (rows 0-350) vs frame 0: max |shift| 0.016 px over all 99 frames
camera.view: street-level side view of a row of shop/house facades across a street; camera slightly yawed so the street direction recedes to the LEFT

perspective_cues.vanishing_point_reliability: rough (+-800 px in x); lines converge to the left, outside the image, so objects moving left along the street move away from the camera
perspective_cues.horizon: not visible (sky not in frame); horizon row roughly y ~ 600 from the vanishing point estimate (uncertain)

cyclist.description: adult man riding a dark-blue city bicycle with silver rims and a rear luggage rack; dark jacket, grey-blue jeans, dark hair, face blurred; nearest the camera of the two figures (rides along the road edge / curb, in front of the pedestrian)
cyclist.direction: right -> left across the whole image and away from the camera (apparent size shrinks steadily)
cyclist.visible_frames: 0-98 (entering: right part cut by the right image edge in frames 0-4; fully inside 5-93; leaving: front wheel cut by the left image edge in frames 94-98)
cyclist.occlusion: never occluded; it passes IN FRONT of the pedestrian in frames ~4-24

pedestrian.description: man in white T-shirt, light-blue jeans and white sneakers walking on the sidewalk next to the facades
pedestrian.direction: right -> left, slowly, also slightly away from the camera (height ~290 px at frame 0 -> ~245 px at frame 98)
pedestrian.occlusion: partly hidden behind the cyclist in frames 5-24 (heaviest ~11-17); box sizes interpolated there, torso x measured

static_objects_px._note: image-axis extents in the median background image (frames/bg.png is NOT kept; any frame shows the same background). x0,x1,y0,y1 inclusive, approximate +-3 px

telephone_booth.desc: white/grey phone booth labelled TELEPHONE at the left, cracked glass

photo_lab_sign.desc: yellow 'PHOTO LAB'O LAB' shop sign band across the left shop

blue_shop_door.desc: blue door with Coca-Cola poster under the Photo Lab sign

trash_can.desc: small dark bin in front of the shop window

stoop_stairs_center.desc: light stone stairs with two wooden banisters leading to the brown door of the green house

brown_door_green_house.desc: brown wooden door of the green clapboard house

hedge_and_iron_fence.desc: low hedge behind a rusty iron railing on a stone base, right of the stoop

arched_wooden_door.desc: tall arched dark-wood door at the right building

manhole_cover_street.desc: round manhole cover in the road, lower right (seen as a flat ellipse)

sidewalk.desc: grey sidewalk between facades and curb; back edge y~640-656, curb top y~655-666 (rises slightly to the left)

events.what: clip starts; both cyclist and pedestrian already moving left (no start of motion inside the clip)
cyclist entering: front wheel and rider visible, rear of bike cut by the right image edge (frames 0-4)
cyclist fully inside the image (bbox_x1 1899 < 1919); its box starts overlapping the pedestrian's box
cyclist passes the pedestrian: cyclist hub midpoint x crosses pedestrian torso x (~frame 14.1); cyclist is in front (closer to camera)
last frame with overlapping boxes; from frame 25 the cyclist is fully left of the pedestrian
cyclist front wheel reaches the left image edge (bbox_x0 ~ 0); frames 94-98 the front of the bike is cut off
clip ends; both still moving; pedestrian still fully visible

no bounce, impact, release or contact; no reversal of direction for either object. Cyclist image-plane speed decreases smoothly (~32 px/frame at frame 1 -> ~12 px/frame at frame 98), mostly from receding along the converging street; pedestrian torso moves a steady ~5-6 px/frame

apparent_size_vs_time_px.cyclist_note: length shrinks faster than height (bike is oblique to the image plane and foreshortens as it recedes to the left); height ratio 0->98 = 1.64
